recognize_zh: 嗜中性球胞質邊緣可見淡藍色、梭形的 Döhle 樣包涵體（實心箭頭，插圖亦同），而血小板大到接近紅血球大小、中央有顆粒（空心箭頭）；巨大血小板加上顆粒球包涵體，是 MYH9 相關疾病（May-Hegglin anomaly）的典型組合。
features: Giant platelets approaching or equaling red cell diameter, with central purple granulomere (open arrows)
Neutrophils with pale blue, spindle-shaped Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions near the cell periphery (solid arrows and insets)
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal, without toxic granulation or vacuolation
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows giant platelets, many approaching the size of adjacent red cells, with an apparent decrease in platelet number. Neutrophils contain pale blue, spindle-shaped Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolation. Red cells are unremarkable. In a patient with a positive family history, findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder); immunofluorescence for aggregated non-muscle myosin IIA and MYH9 genetic testing confirm the diagnosis, and automated counts may underestimate platelets.

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation and vacuolation in a clinical inflammatory setting and are not associated with inherited giant platelets.
Bernard-Soulier shows giant platelets but no neutrophil inclusions and absent ristocetin-induced aggregation (GPIb-IX-V deficiency).
Gray platelets are large but pale and agranular, and neutrophils lack Döhle-like inclusions.
ITP shows modestly enlarged platelets without neutrophil inclusions or family history, and platelet size is less uniformly giant.
